notes.title: Ferocious Bunny is shutting down
notes.notes:
Unfortunately we are unable to continue with Ferocious Bunny and as a result The Fiend's Tavern will no longer be able to be purchased. 

Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoyed our game.

notes.title: Let there be bright
notes.notes:
Brightness setting added in paused game menu so that you can view the changes in real time.

The brightness is set low initially.

notes.title: Game start issue is resolved
notes.notes:
We have fixed the issue where the okay button on new tavern name was not working.

We appologize for the oversite.

We hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Name Change - The Fiend's Tavern
notes.notes:
Hi all.

Tavern Keep's name has changed, to The Fiend's Tavern...

Don't be alarmed, the game is still the same, and should update automatically, you wont need to repurchase the game (Not that I needed to type that.).

As usual.

Enjoy the game :D

Ferocious Bunny Devs.

notes.title: Tavern Keep saves like a boss! 2.0
notes.notes:
Tavern Keeps save system has been reworked and redesigned.

Unfortunatly you will have to start a new game but now there will be no blank adventurers.

We also fixed some grammatical errors.

thank you for playing our game and we hope you enjoy.

notes.title: Tavern Keep is alive!!!!
notes.notes:
We apologise for the Tavern Keep file not previously downloading, but we have resolved the issue, and it will download.

We apologise for the inconvenience.

And we hope you enjoy the game.

Feel free to open a discussion, if you have any queries or issues, or would just lke to say hi.

We will try to respond to any discussion as quick as we can.

And thank you for purchasing our first game!

ENJOY!!!!
